description: The homepage hero's real em/clamp scaling system, deliberately preserved (not flattened to fixed pixels) per README.md:31-33 and Hero.jsx's own doc comment.
rule: Every child of .hero_visual is authored in `em`, relative to this clamped root — NOT converted to fixed px at build time. This is the mechanism the README calls out as 'preserved rather than flattened'.

belowBreakpoint.behavior: .hero_visual is display:none; .hero_mobile (a horizontal tag rail + horizontally-scrolling card row) takes over.
